title: NASA figured out how to keep its Voyager 2 probe running for another year

processed.summary:
- NASA engineers have successfully diverted **backup power** from an onboard safety mechanism to keep scientific instruments operational on the Voyager 2 probe.
- The mission extension addresses the declining power output of the **Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generators (RTGs)**, which lose roughly 4 watts per year.
- By utilizing a **voltage reservoir** buffer, the team avoided shutting down an instrument, enabling the 48-year-old spacecraft to continue interstellar data transmission.
key_results: Voyager 2 mission life extended through at least 2026.
